aboutMore: ok some serious stuff (3 sentences). my mom says ur mom back and its the best day of my life every time. my little brother gabe is 12 and plays runescape and has never laughed at anything i said except once, by accident, and i dont know what it was. my nana betty watches every ytmnd i make on the library computer and votes 5 and then calls me to ask why theres a picard. we still have the box the gateway came in (the cow one) and gabe lives in it. i can do 4 voices: strong bad, picard, a pirate, and my gym teacher (he knows).

blog.title: OFFICIAL REVIEW: THE SCHOOL LUNCH (rated in faces out of 10)
blog.body: rectangle pizza: 7 faces. the rectangle is a lie but the lie is warm. corn: 4 faces. the corn knows what it is and i respect that. chicken patty: 9 faces. nobody knows what bird. nobody asks. it is a mystery sandwich and we love it. the salad (a cup of lettuce): 2 faces. it came with one cherry tomato who looked scared. the milk: 6 faces. it has a date on it and the date is never today. green jello w/ fruit inside: 10 faces. its a snow globe u can eat. there has been a grape trapped in there since august. i think about that grape. what is its story. its 12:48 am and im thinking about a grape. mrs ferris the lunch lady said 'thats a nice thing to say about a grape' and gave me 2 jellos. shes my favorite person in the school. ur mom is second (lol).

blog.title: the mystery voter (SOLVED)
blog.body: ok so every ytmnd i make has 3 votes. 2 are mine (dont tell anyone). the 3rd was always a 5 and i assumed it was randy voting 1 and the site had a glitch. (nick voted 5 on the eraser one once. thats a different 5. thats a friend 5. i keep it in a sleeve.) then at dinner my mom said 'nana says your picard is very good.' i said 'how does nana know about the picard.' it turns out nana betty goes to the peoria public library tuesdays and thursdays after bridge club, signs in with her library card, and votes 5 on every single one i make. including the one with the epic face spinning for 9 minutes (she watched all 9). i called her. i asked if she gets it. she said 'not at all.' she said 'is the picard a friend of yours?' i said 'kind of.' she said 'tell him hello.' im telling him hello. hello picard. nana if ur reading this (she isnt, she cant find the site) thank u. its the only 5 that counts. randy is cleared of all charges (sorry randy) (not that sorry).

blog.title: A TRIP TO THE MALL IN A MINIVAN (41 'are we there yets')
blog.body: we went to the big mall in bloomington so my mom could return a lamp. its an hour away. i said 'are we there yet' as a bit and it was funny for 4 minutes and then it was the same bit for 56 minutes. i said it 41 times. gabe said it once and my mom pulled over. i got a pretzel. i walked past a store that sells only lamps, a different lamp store, which is when i knew the universe was trying to tell my mom something about her lamp. we returned the lamp. we bought a different lamp. 2 hours in a car for one lamp. on the way home my mom said 'next time you can stay home' and i said 'who will do the bit' and she said 'your father' and i said 'ur mom' and she laughed so hard she missed our exit. so we took the next one. its called pekin. i bought a sticker.

blog.title: HOW 2 MAKE A YTMND (a tutorial) (if randy reads this ur mom)
blog.body: 1. pick an image. the dumber the better. 2. pick a sound that loops. 4 seconds is ideal. the loop has to feel like a mistake u cant stop. 3. put text on it. white. big. 4. add one thing that doesnt belong (a pig, picard, a guy in a suit). 5. dont explain it. 6. show it to ONE friend. 7. watch 3 votes come in. 8. the votes dont matter. the loop matters. 9. wait till somebody walks in on it and laughs at the part where the guy looks at the camera. thats the whole thing. thats a win. i have 40 sites and 1 has 12 votes but the one i love is the one where my mom walked in and said 'what is that' and then stood there for the whole loop. she watched 14 loops. she said 'its dumb.' she didnt leave.
